title: Score sheet components

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 2034048 (0x001f0980), HLP file offset 513909 (0x0007d775), topic 313 'Score sheet'

setup.baseline: A controlled game with known planet, starbase, ship, tech and resource totals.
setup.variable: One scored asset at a time.

procedure: Record score before and after adding one planet, starbase, unarmed ship, escort and capital ship.
Record tech-level and resource score contributions at boundaries.
Verify the capital-ship formula with several ship/planet counts.
Check public-score visibility before and after turn 20.

documented: Planets score 1-6 points, 1 per 100,000 colonists; starbases 3 points each excluding Orbital Forts (documented-only).
Unarmed ships score 1/2 point each up to the planet count; escorts score 2 each up to the planet count (documented-only).
Capital ships score (8 x ships x planets)/(ships + planets); tech levels score 1-4 by band; resources score 1 per 30 (documented-only).
History graph covers the last 100 years; public scores appear after turn 20 if enabled (documented-only).

unresolved: The exact planet score curve and rounding are not decoded.
Power-rating definitions for unarmed/escort/capital classes depend on the unrecovered combat data.
